data.title: ChatGPT Lawsuit: OpenAI Accused of Using Kids’ Data
data.description: A proposed class action says OpenAI let minors sign up for ChatGPT without real parental consent and used their chats to train AI. No class is certified.
data.author: Steve Levine
data.keywords: ChatGPT kids lawsuit, OpenAI class action minors, ChatGPT parental consent lawsuit, OpenAI children’s data, ChatGPT teens privacy, Doe v. OpenAI Foundation, California Family Code 6701, Civil Code 1568.5, ChatGPT terms of use minors, OpenAI equity lawsuit
